赛博法师 AI技巧分享会流程: The Cyber Casters AI practice-sharing meetup
每位参会人提前准备一个本人实际使用过、效果较好的AI技巧或完整方案。为避免给参会: Each participant prepares an AI technique or complete solution they have used successfully. There is no ranking of topics or techniques, and no pressure to bring something impressive. Share freely.
分享内容可参考“应用场景—具体做法—实际效果—适用边界”的结构准备，必要时可以准: A useful structure is: context → steps → results → limitations. Bring a screenshot, example or live demonstration if helpful.
由于可能涉及客户、项目、合同或其他敏感信息，除非征得分享人同意，不录屏、不拍照。: Client, project, contract or other sensitive information may be involved. Do not record or photograph a presentation without the speaker’s consent.
主持人简要说明本次分享会的目标和流程。如有新成员，快速介绍。: The host briefly explains the goals and process. New participants introduce themselves.
（二）AI技巧或方案分享（60分钟）: 2. AI technique or solution sharing (60 minutes)
每位参会人依次分享一个实践效果最好的AI技巧或方案。建议按照以下结构展开：: Each participant shares a technique or solution that has worked well in practice. Suggested structure:
原来遇到了什么问题，为什么需要使用AI；: What problem did you face, and why did you turn to AI?
使用了什么工具、提示词、工作流或操作步骤；: Which tools, prompts, workflows or steps did you use?
在时间、质量、准确性或工作体验方面带来了什么改善，可提供数据或前后对比；: What improved in time, quality, accuracy or the work experience? Include data or a before-and-after comparison if possible.
当前方案仍存在哪些不足、风险，或者不适用于哪些场景；: What limitations or risks remain, and where is the approach unsuitable?
如果其他人想尝试，最先可以从哪一步开始。: Where should someone else start if they want to try it?
其他参会人可以将问题或感兴趣的内容记录，或与分享人进行机动讨论。: Other participants can note questions or topics of interest, or discuss them informally with the speaker.
全部方案分享完成后，请每位参会人独立选择除本人以外“最想尝试”的一个方案。: After all presentations, each participant independently chooses the approach, other than their own, they most want to try.
我最想尝试的是________的方案。: The approach I most want to try is ________’s.
对我最有价值的地方是________。: The most valuable part for me is ________.
我准备将它用于________场景。: I plan to use it in ________.
我建议进一步增加、调整或验证________，因为________。: I suggest adding, changing or testing ________, because ________.
完善建议尽量落到具体动作，例如增加核验环节、明确适用条件、补充标准模板、简化操作: Make improvements actionable: add verification, clarify conditions for use, supply a standard template, simplify steps, define success metrics or strengthen data controls. Avoid vague suggestions such as “optimize it more” or “make it smarter.”
被评价人可以作回应，说明是否采纳、需要进一步验证的事项或者必要的背景信息。: The speaker can respond, explain whether they will adopt the suggestion, identify what needs testing or provide relevant context.
主持人选择一至两个被多次提及、对多数人有价值的问题进行集中讨论，每位参会人亦可提: The host selects one or two frequently mentioned questions of broad interest for discussion. Everyone may also ask their own questions.
对于被多次选择、具有较高复用价值方案的分享人，由全体参会人表达感谢，并由分享人发: The group thanks speakers whose approaches were often selected and have strong reuse potential, and invites them to reflect.
我分享这个技巧的心态是________。: My intention in sharing this technique is ________.
进一步的规划和期待是________。: My further plans and hopes are ________.
目前需要获得的支持是________。: The support I currently need is ________.
希望在座各位做________。: I would like everyone here to ________.
主持人感谢全体参会人的分享，面对面建群，说明纪要预计发送时间，确定是否安排下一次: The host thanks everyone, brings the group together on WeChat, explains when minutes are expected and discusses a possible next meetup.
记录人在会后形成简要纪要。参会人可在微信群内对当期内容再次讨论，回访收集各方案的: A note-taker prepares a brief record. Participants may continue the discussion in WeChat, report what happened when they tried the approaches, and share new AI developments.
经验证有效的方案可以进一步整理为AI操作指引、标准提示词或工作流模板，使会议成果: Methods that prove useful can be developed into AI guides, standard prompts or workflow templates, gradually turning meetup outcomes into reusable knowledge.

Skill 为什么没触发: Why a skill did not trigger
盘符不一层、配置被覆盖、记忆太长，都会让钩子静音。: Mismatched locations, overwritten settings and long memories can silence hooks.
说明文件只是提醒；精简上下文，关键节点要验收。: Keep context concise and verify required steps at milestones.
文风和态度写进工作区；不清楚就用选择题问。: Capture tone in the workspace and clarify uncertainty with multiple-choice questions.
工程目录 + 精简知识库；人只看自己真正关心的那截。: Organized folders and a concise knowledge base show people what matters.
主线不跑重活；长对话用交接文档续，而不是靠自动压缩。: Keep heavy work in separate conversations and use deliberate handoffs.
白名单信息流；境内搜索仍是短板。: An allowlisted information feed; mainland search remains a challenge.
大纲骨架 + 句级出处，长报告才能稳定。: A fixed framework and sentence-level sources stabilize long reports.
过程与结果分开；先验证单人工作流。: Separate process from output and validate individual workflows first.
公开资料怎么采、怎么核、怎么接到本地库。: Gather and verify public sources, then connect them to a local library.
把经验写成可复用 Skill，分层存放。: Turn experience into reusable skills organized in layers.
格式与工具的效率账: The efficiency of formats and tools
Markdown 更适 AI；Word 场景选对工具，成本差很大。: Markdown suits AI; choosing the right Word tool changes the cost substantially.
本地转写脱敏后，再交给可信模型整理。: Transcribe locally before asking a trusted model to structure the notes.
转写、录音设备与日常纪要流程怎么串。: Connect transcription, recording devices and everyday note-taking.
口述成文；先有结构，效果更好。: Turn speech into writing; structured dictation improves the result.
本地文件夹协作，编辑器里跨模型切换。: Work with local folders and switch models inside an editor.
Skill 与多角色协作；瓶颈常在需求与测试。: Skills and specialist roles help; requirements and testing often remain the bottleneck.
隔离主机跑助手，兼顾出门访问与接入。: Run assistants on an isolated host with access while away.
一项目一空间：背景、材料、记忆分区。: One space per project, with background, documents and memories.
接外部数据与工具；能走多远看数据开放度。: Connect external data and tools; access depends on source openness.
同步、模板、图片归档与编辑器联动。: Sync, templates, image assets and editor integration.
映射规则 + 样式模板，Markdown 一键出 Word。: Mapping rules and style templates turn Markdown into Word.
